Name: Gem Lamp Posts Mod
Author: Digus
Description:
[size=3][b]Current version: [/b]1.0.1[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Korean i18n. (Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48693548]KAYA[/url]﻿)[/size]
[*][size=2]Adding nexus key to manifest so people get update alerts.[/size]
[*][size=2]Adding dependencies to the manifest.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Objective: [/size][/b]
To provide the player with lamp-posts that produce light based on gem color.

[size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=2][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8292/]Unzip the Gem Lamp Posts Mod[/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿ into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536/]Unzip the Mail Framework Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970/]Unzip the Producer Framework Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720/]Unzip the Json Assets Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]How does it work[/b]:[/size]
[list]
[*]The Wizard will send you a letter teaching you the recipe once you have
find a variety of gems and have a good relationship with him. [spoiler]1 of each precious gem and 5 heart friendship[/spoiler][*]Once you have a Gem Lamp-post, you can place gems inside it to produce light of the color of the gem.
[*]The Gem will be consumed in the next morning and you can take the Gem Dust from the machine.
[*]You can place up to 7 gems in the Lamp-post, it will be lit for as many
days as the amount of gems you placed. The same amount of Gem Dust can be collected afterwards.[*]Once you have created a Gem Lamp-post and gave a relationship with a secret character, the wizard will tell
you about buying the Gem Lamp-post variants. [spoiler]2 heart friendship with Dwarf[/spoiler][*]Once you have produced enough Gem Dust and have a good relationship with a specific character, you will receive
the recipe for the Gem Composer in the mail. [spoiler]5 Gem Dusts and 4 heart friendship with Demetrius[/spoiler][*]The Gem Composer has a chance to recreate the Gem from 5 Gem Dust. It can also produce a
random gem from the dust. Probabilities: [spoiler][list]
[*]80% : The same gem
[*]1%: Prismatic Shard
[*]19%: Any of the vanilla gems besides the Prismatic Shard.
[/list][/spoiler][/list][size=3][b]
Internationalization:[/b][/size]
[size=2]It has an official translation for pt-BR.[/size][size=2]
Feel free to send me a translation to your language and I might add it on future versions.

[*][size=2]Delete the mod from the installation folder.[/size]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: (JA)Gem Lamp Posts Mod
Manifest.Description: Adds Lamp-posts to the game that are fueled by Gems. Gem dust can be used to create new gems with the Gem Composer.
Manifest.Author: Digus
